# Lucide icons

source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

revision: `53fab88ff9d1b48f4704b5b5b560d6b4d560bf4c`

the SVGs in this directory are copied unchanged from the upstream `icons/` directory. `LICENSE` is copied from the repository root.

22 SVGs are embedded: generic file, folder, symbolic link, document, code, image, audio, video, archive, spreadsheet, font, terminal, database, two sort indicators, and seven places icons. the documents place reuses the document icon. SDL3_image renders them at the current display scale. the renderer replaces `currentColor` with white before loading, then applies a neutral gray texture color. the geometry is unchanged.
